From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>

Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-03-01T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Redwood discovery - AtlasOps

Hi Sanjay —

Thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

Summary of what I heard:
- You currently run a mix of open models in a hybrid setup; main pain: unpredictable latency during peak ETL windows and rising token costs.
- Primary goals: reduce per-token cost by ~30% and get consistent p95 latency under 200ms for customer-facing suggestions.
- Constraints: procurement requires SOC2 evidence and a security review; some workloads must stay in your VPC.

Proposed next steps (from our side):
1) Shared MAP & pricing: I attached a rough Mutual Action Plan and a starter pricing spreadsheet for a 6-month pilot.
2) Technical deep-dive: Schedule a 45-min session with our infra engineer (we can do next week).
3) Compliance kickoff: I can loop in our security lead for the SOC2 questionnaire if you want to start that now.

Would you be available for the technical deep-dive on Wed 3/10 or Thu 3/11? If neither works, tell me a time that does and I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments:
- 20260301-AtlasOps-MAP.pdf (PDF, mutual action plan)
- MVP_pricing.xlsx (Excel, starter pricing)

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
